SECTION C: Short Answer Type Questions (3 Marks Each)

Q27. (a) “Tertiary sector is not playing any significant role in the development of Indian 
economy.” Do you agree? Give reasons in support of your answer.  
OR  
(b) “Public sector contributes to the economic development of India.” Justify the 
statement.

Answer / Solution:
(a) “Tertiary sector is not playing any significant role in the development of Indian 
economy.” Do you agree? Give reasons. 
No, I do not agree. It is the largest producing sector. 
Reasons: (1) It provides basic services (health, education). (2) It supports 
agriculture and industry (transport, trade). (3) Income rise boosts demand for 
services like tourism and shopping. 
OR (b) “Public sector contributes to the economic development of India.” Justify the 
statement. 
It builds infrastructure (railways, power) requiring huge investment. 
It promotes regional balance by setting up industries in backward areas. 
It ensures social welfare and affordable services.
